visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with shoulder-length wavy dark hair, wearing a blue denim shirt over a striped undershirt, stands in an indoor living room. He holds a white ceramic bowl decorated with red flowers, containing six pale, frozen dumplings. The background features a grey fabric sofa and a plain light grey wall. (2) A close-up shot focuses on the bowl of dumplings placed on a light-colored wooden surface. A clear stream of hot water is poured from an off-screen kettle, partially submerging the dumplings. Steam rises from the hot water, and a yellow text overlay appears at the bottom. (3) The scene shifts to a kitchen shelf where the man places the bowl inside a black microwave oven. He closes the door with a firm hand movement and manipulates the control panel. The microwave has a textured glass door reflecting the surrounding room lights. (4) Wearing thick, olive-green quilted oven mitts, the man opens the microwave door. He carefully lifts the steaming bowl of dumplings out of the appliance and moves it toward the camera. His facial expression shows intense concentration and anticipation as he handles the hot bowl. (5) The camera provides a top-down view of the dumplings floating in the hot water. He uses a small metal mesh strainer to scoop them out and place them in another bowl. A bright red arrow graphic points to a small tear in one of the dumpling skins. (6) A close-up shot shows a single dumpling held up by wooden chopsticks. The dumpling is bitten in half, revealing a minced meat and green vegetable filling. The interior looks moist and steaming, and the man's face appears in a small circular inset at the bottom. (7) Back to a medium shot, the man sits on the grey sofa, holding the bowl of cooked dumplings. He gestures with his hands while speaking, showing an expressive facial expression with wide eyes and a smile, indicating enthusiasm for the successful cooking results.
